name: 72936 · Greenwood, AR
findings: ZIP 72936 (Greenwood) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72936 (Greenwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72936 (Greenwood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
